facts.text: The cheapest early experiments are small tests that can start immediately using existing data and one machine, designed to prove the proposal wrong before expensive infrastructure is built.
facts.quote: The cheapest early experiments are small tests that can start immediately, with existing data and one machine, and are designed to prove the proposal wrong before expensive infrastructure is built.

facts.text: Chapter 13 identifies sixteen cheapest early experiments, each with a produced artifact and a signal for stopping or escalating the program.
facts.quote: Chapter 13 lists sixteen such experiments, each with the artifact it produces and the signal that should stop or escalate the program.

facts.text: A supplier data-room drill should test whether the required sensor, brake and controller data can be obtained with legal rights.
facts.quote: a supplier data-room drill (can the needed sensor, brake and controller data be obtained with legal rights?)

facts.text: A single “golden thread” credibility slice should carry one requirement from a real test through a model and virtual result to a decision.
facts.quote: a single "golden thread" credibility slice (one requirement carried from real test to model to virtual result to decision)

facts.text: An early credibility-framework dry run should use EU Regulation 2022/1426 Annex III.
facts.quote: a credibility-framework dry run against EU Regulation 2022/1426 Annex III

facts.text: Open-loop replay of existing warning-system logs through candidate braking logic should estimate the false-activation rate before new hardware exists.
facts.quote: open-loop replay of existing warning-system logs through candidate braking logic, to estimate the false-activation rate before new hardware exists

facts.text: Physical-versus-virtual correlation for one machine and one scenario should be reported as residual plots and an uncertainty budget, rather than judged as “looks close.”
facts.quote: one machine, one scenario, physical versus virtual correlation, reported as residual plots and an uncertainty budget rather than "looks close"

facts.text: A sensor-model correlation pilot should test one sensor in one dust or fog condition and be judged on detection outcomes.
facts.quote: a sensor-model correlation pilot for one sensor in one dust or fog condition, judged on detection outcomes

facts.text: A weather falsification test should determine whether simulated rain or dust reproduces measured sensor degradation, not merely its appearance.
facts.quote: a weather falsification test (does simulated rain or dust reproduce measured sensor degradation, not just appearance?)

facts.text: An early physical stopping-distance matrix should cover two machine families, three surfaces and grades.
facts.quote: a physical stopping-distance matrix over two machine families, three surfaces and grades

facts.text: A calibration perturbation test should determine whether small mounting changes move the brake trigger.
facts.quote: a calibration perturbation test (do small mounting changes move the brake trigger?)

facts.text: A machine-variant portability test is recommended as a cheapest early experiment.
facts.quote: a machine-variant portability test

facts.text: A shadow-mode intervention study on real sites is recommended as a cheapest early experiment.
facts.quote: a shadow-mode intervention study on real sites

facts.text: Winter 2026 to 2027 data should be captured before the season passes.
facts.quote: a winter 2026 to 2027 data capture before the season passes

facts.text: An end-to-end throughput benchmark should include human triage.
facts.quote: an end-to-end throughput benchmark including human triage

facts.text: Notified-body and counsel pre-consultation is recommended as a cheapest early experiment.
facts.quote: notified-body and counsel pre-consultation

facts.text: A safety and legal dry run should examine one evidence package.
facts.quote: a safety and legal dry run on one evidence package

facts.text: An operator clinic should measure nuisance-stop tolerance.
facts.quote: an operator clinic measuring nuisance-stop tolerance

facts.text: Investment should be ordered behind four questions: whether required data can be obtained, whether one representative system can be correlated to reality, whether that credibility transfers to a second materially different configuration, and whether safety and legal reviewers accept the resulting evidence.
facts.quote: can we obtain the required data; can we correlate one representative system to reality; can we transfer that credibility to a second, materially different configuration; will the safety and legal reviewers accept the resulting evidence.

facts.text: Failure at any of the four early investment gates is more informative before a full platform has been built than afterward.
facts.quote: Failure at any step is more informative now than after a full platform has been built
